name: Tiny Ironquill
description:
A Fluffahog that was once sealed in ice and thus is related to an ancient bloodline.
Just as ice and snow that have been sliced away by the frigid winds once had fresh contours, the small animals now known as Fluffahogs were also once harsh, sharp things. However, no scholar has been able to truly discover the giant Fluffahogs written of in traditional tales. This may be because these primeval beings had the ability to shapeshift.
